title: The Digital Lives of the Poor: Entertainment Traps and Information Isolation
eligible_reason: Randomized experiment assigning participants to a capped or standard data plan. Estimating equation is Y_it = a + b*T_i + psi*H_it + tau*T_i*H_it + g*Z_i + delta_t with date fixed effects, no unit fixed effects. Treatment is time-invariant random assignment; 'staggered' refers only to staggered enrollment dates, not staggered treatment adoption.
design_notes: Main text Eq. (1). Controls Z_i are baseline covariates; H_it is a within-plan-cycle indicator (second half of a 4-week plan), not a treatment adoption indicator. Clustered at participant. Pre-registered (AEARCTR-0004594).
estimators_reported: randomized ITT regression with date fixed effects
screener_notes: Ineligible: RCT. Full-text hit for 'staggered' is the staggered enrollment sentence.
